subject: key_station
prompt:
29 May 1919, late morning, Roça Sundy cocoa plantation on Príncipe island. A cleared terrace of wet red earth. An open-sided timber sun-shelter with a rolled-back canvas roof covers a long horizontal telescope tube on wooden trestles. At the far end a flat circular coelostat mirror sits on a squat brick pier with a small wooden clockwork drive box; it reflects sunlight into the tube. Two Edwardian British astronomers in pale tropical clothes, one in a pith helmet, work at the near end of the tube beside a plain wooden table with a chronometer. Wooden packing crates. A whitewashed plantation house with a red tile roof in the background, palms and cocoa trees. Heavy grey-white cumulus clouds drifting across a pale sun.

Materials read as their real substance (wood, brass, canvas, glass, brick) through color and broad texture, not micro-detail. The scientific evidence of the scene is the brightest and clearest thing in the frame. Real historical people are depicted respectfully, never as caricatures.
Game concept frame, 16:9, eye-level first-person viewpoint at 1.65 m, 50 mm-equivalent lens (about 60° horizontal field of view), no fisheye, no dutch angle. Clear foreground / midground / background separation.
